description: This file defines a Perl class for handling a result set related to blacklisted emails within a database schema, including methods for adding emails to the blacklist and checking email validity.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::BlacklistEmail
classes.description: A class representing a result set for blacklisted emails, extending the base ResultSet class and including methods for managing email blacklists.

methods.name: add_email
methods.description: Adds a literal email address to the blacklist.

methods.name: is_email_ok
methods.description: Checks if an email address is considered okay (not blacklisted).

methods.name: _blacklist_default_type
methods.description: Returns the default hashing type used for blacklisting emails.

methods.name: _blacklist_type_column
methods.description: Returns the name of the database column storing the email type.

methods.name: _blacklist_value_column
methods.description: Returns the name of the database column storing the email value.
